title: Every archived signal ticketed by the production mechanics and walked over the records' own bars
freeze_rule: Signals in publications for sessions up to and including frozen_through_session are EXPLORATORY: their next closes were public before this spec was written. Signals in later publications are CONFIRMATORY. No rule, threshold or population choice below may change after this file is committed; a change starts a new spec with a new freeze.

population.source: the first publication of each session among the publications listed below, by run.published_at; a later publication of the same session is a revision that contributes bars and no signals
population.rows: every row of bursts[] in that publication

strata.admitted: grade_mechanical in pipeline.TRADE_GRADES (A+, A) with vetoes empty: what a GREEN night admits before the reader

population.control: the admitted stratum is read against B, C, skip and vetoed on the same nights; the reader-accepted A/A+ rows are reported as their own stratum

ticket.function: plan.burst_plan with the publication's own account block, size_multiplier breadth.SIZE_MULTIPLIER['green'], scan 'dollar' for a dollar-only row else '4pct', the row's extension_pct and gain_pct (0.0 when absent): exactly pipeline._make_plans's inputs
ticket.gate: the regime gate, the slot cap and the cash budget are NOT applied; every ticket stands on its own
ticket.no_ticket: a plan that is not eligible, has no order action or no shares is bucketed no_ticket with its reason; a plan the module refuses to build is plan_error
ticket.pick: pipeline.pick_of over the plan, dated the signal session; record.pick_problem must be None

bars.sources: every listed publication's observations.symbols[*].history, observations.symbols[*] latest bar and bursts[*].series, in publication order, the newest winning
bars.revision: a later publication's bar differing from the one it replaces by more than 0.005 in open, high, low or close is counted as a revision with both values
bars.basis: a signal whose own close is not reproduced by the gathered bar on its session (within 0.005) is bucketed basis_mismatch and never walked

walk.function: record.replay over the record.OPEN_PLAN_SESSIONS (plan.FINAL_EXIT_DAY) sessions after the signal, through the newest listed session; record.r_multiple against the pick's published stop
walk.buckets: record.SCORECARD_BUCKETS exactly as record.scorecard_rows assigns them (pending on the newest session, unmeasured without bars, uncertain/not_filled/unreadable by status, settled with an R, open while the walk continues), plus no_ticket, plan_error and basis_mismatch
walk.uncertain_bound: an uncertain ticket is scored nowhere; beside it, plan.follow from the trigger over the same bars gives the R it would have had if the uncertain day had filled at the trigger, reported as a labelled bound and never pooled into the result

estimands.E1_primary: per stratum: the count and sum of R of settled tickets, the mean and median R, wins/losses/breakeven, the per-night mean R, and the mean of per-night means with a night-block bootstrap 95% interval (nights resampled with replacement)
estimands.E2: the same for the admitted stratum split into exploratory and confirmatory signals; only the confirmatory split can be read as evidence
estimands.E3: the same for the reader-accepted A/A+ rows: the live policy's own admissions
estimands.E4: R after a per-side cost on the fill and every sale at cost_bps_per_side, in R units

reading_rule: No rate is read under record.SCORECARD_MIN_PLANS settled tickets in a stratum (record.summarize_scorecard's own rule). No statistic here is an edge claim: every ticket was refused by the RED gate and the reader is not run. Nothing is tuned: no threshold, no rule and no population is changed in response to these numbers.
